2026_02_MIA_SF.headline: Miami’s extended West Coast stay meets San Francisco’s home-opening momentum
2026_02_MIA_SF.paragraph1: Miami stayed in Northern California after its opening loss, using the week in Napa to reduce the travel burden before facing San Francisco. The 49ers return to Levi’s Stadium after a 27-7 win over the Rams in Australia and are seeking another composed performance after their own unusual travel schedule. The Dolphins need to generate early-down efficiency and prevent San Francisco’s rush from controlling the game; the 49ers can press their advantage by making Miami chase from behind.
2026_02_MIA_SF.model_rationale: Miami’s early-down execution and protection must withstand San Francisco’s defensive pressure, while the 49ers need to manage travel recovery without sacrificing their Week 1 physicality.
